Definition
[Euclidean logarithmic Sobolev inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0358 1. ch16:16.33\group Entropy Rigidity

The Euclidean logarithmic Sobolev inequality is \[ \int _M\left(\frac12|\nabla f|^2+f-n\right)u\, d\mu \ge 0 \] for every $u=(2\pi )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$ with $\int _Mu\, d\mu =1$.
